sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code official model card
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint card labels total parameters 1T, activated parameters 32B and architecture MoE; documents 61 layers, MLA and MoonViT; identifies K2.6 lineage, native INT4 weights, image/video input, text generation and interleaved reasoning/tool calls.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code Modified MIT License
sources.evidence: Exact repository license is titled Modified MIT License, copyright 2026 Moonshot AI, and contains a Kimi K2.7 Code attribution condition for commercial services above stated scale thresholds.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code checkpoint configuration at pinned revision
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint config sets text model_type kimi_k2, max_position_embeddings 262144, 384 routed experts, 8 experts per token and one shared expert; includes vision configuration and packed 4-bit quantization. Pinned revision 74797c9c62378b951a1f6fcf5c4631024e9b8bef has no next-token-prediction layers.

sources.title: Kimi K2.7 Code API quickstart
sources.evidence: Names exact kimi-k2.7-code API ID, documents 256K context and multimodal text-generation examples, explicitly disallows non-thinking mode, and documents multi-step tool calling with auto/none tool_choice.

sources.title: Kimi Code changelog: Kimi K2.7 Code release
sources.evidence: Explicit Model Release entry dated June 12, 2026 states Kimi K2.7 Code is released, open-sourced, and available in Kimi For Coding with Thinking On.

sources.title: Kimi K2.7 Code official model overview
sources.evidence: Overview updated October 8, 2026 identifies Moonshot AI as developer, directly confirms MoE with 1T total/32B activated parameters, downloadable Hugging Face weights, 262144-token context, and text/image/video inputs.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code repository commit history
sources.evidence: Repository initial commit was June 11, 2026 at 07:51:47 UTC; weight upload commit da26fe4 followed at 08:14:26 UTC. Commit dates do not establish when a possibly staged repository became public.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code repository metadata and file listing
sources.evidence: Live repository is public and ungated with 64 safetensors shards. Automatic metadata reports 1026879376368, but includes I32 classification; the accepted exact count instead reconstructs logical INT4 shapes and excludes quantization metadata using the pinned checkpoint headers.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code complete tensor index at pinned revision
sources.evidence: Index maps 208550 unique tensor keys to 64 shards. The completed census reconciled every indexed key against its shard header, with no missing or duplicate keys.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code language-model implementation at pinned revision
sources.evidence: Defines attention, embeddings, dense/shared/routed experts and norms. Router e_score_correction_bias is explicitly nn.Parameter and is included. Configuration/implementation arithmetic yields 1026408232448 language-model parameters, agreeing with the complete header census.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code vision and projector implementation at pinned revision
sources.evidence: Defines MoonViT and PatchMergerMLP. Spatial position embeddings are parameters; time_weight and freqs_cis are nonpersistent buffers. Code/config arithmetic yields 416866032 vision parameters and 54277888 projector parameters, matching all corresponding shard headers.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code headers of all 64 indexed shards at pinned revision
sources.evidence: Bounded Range reads covered all 64 index-listed shard headers (model-00001 through model-00064-of-000064.safetensors). Census validates dtype/shape byte spans and excludes 69120 weight_scale plus 69120 weight_shape tensors. Each of 69120 I32 packed expert matrices represents eight INT4 values per stored element; 1190 unpacked parameter tensors remain. Reconstructed full total is 1026879376368; representative shards 1, 2, 63 and 64 were independently re-fetched during review.

developer.note: Explicit developer attribution and repository copyright.

family.note: K2.6 lineage and exact checkpoint text model_type kimi_k2 support the existing family grouping.

release_date.note: Retain explicit official public-release date. June 11 repository preparation/upload timestamps are earlier, but do not independently establish public availability then; record this distinction rather than silently replacing the announcement date.

open_weights.note: Official released checkpoint has publicly accessible, ungated weight shards; this is not merely a hosted API model.

license.note: Exact checkpoint license, not an inference from K2.5/K2.6 or ordinary unmodified MIT.

parameters_b.note: Complete checkpoint total: 1026408232448 language + 416866032 vision + 54277888 projector = 1026879376368 parameters (1026.879376368B). All 208550 index entries across 64 pinned shard headers reconcile with independent configuration/implementation arithmetic. Count logical INT4 matrix values after packing reconstruction; exclude scales, shape metadata and nonpersistent buffers. Include router correction biases explicitly declared as parameters. Card 1T is nominal; no sibling counts are transferred.

active_parameters_b.note: Exact variant explicitly reports nominal 32B activated per token. Retained as the developer disclosure, distinct from the exact complete checkpoint total; no exact active count including vision and projector is asserted.

architecture.note: Exact variant explicitly uses MoE with MLA; config corroborates 384 routed experts, 8 selected and one shared expert.

context_window.note: 262144 is both the documented supported context and checkpoint max_position_embeddings. The API default 32768 max_tokens is an output-generation setting, not context.

modalities.note: Exact variant documents text, image and video inputs with generated text/chat output.

reasoning.note: Explicit thinking-model classification: non-thinking mode is unsupported and disabling thinking returns an error.

tool_call.note: Exact model quickstart documents multi-step tool use and supported tool_choice values.

description.value: Coding-focused multimodal reasoning model built on Kimi K2.6, with open weights and multi-step tool calling.
description.note: Replace broad comparative wording with supported task focus, lineage and capabilities; no independent benchmark superiority claim.

patch.notes: Exact complete checkpoint: 1026.408232448B language + 0.416866032B vision encoder + 0.054277888B projector = 1026.879376368B. All 64 pinned headers reconcile with independent configuration/code arithmetic; logical INT4 weights are reconstructed, scales and shape metadata excluded, and router correction-bias parameters included. Published 1T total and 32B active are nominal; active remains the developer-reported figure without an exact vision-inclusive claim. Official public-release announcement is June 12, 2026; June 11 upload timestamps alone do not establish earlier public availability. Modified MIT weights; thinking is always enabled.

summary: All 14 fields verified against exact-model primary sources. Complete checkpoint total is 1026.879376368B, reconciled across all 64 pinned shard headers and independent configuration/code arithmetic; logical INT4 reconstruction excludes quantization metadata. Retain nominal active 32B. Add MoE and Modified MIT, neutral description and primary provenance. Confirm released weights, 262144 context, text/image/video input, text output, mandatory reasoning and tool calling. Retain explicit June 12 release announcement while recording June 11 repository preparation timestamps.
